mapper.select: SELECT run_id::text AS runId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, state::text AS state, completed_at AS completedAt, error_code AS errorCode, CASE WHEN state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN result_payload->>'content' END AS explanation FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenantId, knowledge_point AS knowledgePoint, error_type AS errorType, confidence AS confidence FROM weakness_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenantId, step_number AS stepNumber, state::text AS state, step_type AS stepType, output_payload::text AS output FROM run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid ORDER BY step_number ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT operation_id::text AS operationId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, tool_name AS toolName, state::text AS state FROM tool_operation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND state = 'UNKNOWN' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 50
